scenarios.story: The provider routes a share of traffic to a cheaper or more heavily quantised variant. Nothing in the API contract changes. The answers stay grammatical and polite and stop containing the order number, the amount or the action taken.
scenarios.symptom: answers become fluent, shorter and free of specifics
scenarios.title: Silent model swap

scenarios.story: A marketing push brings in a different cohort and the topic mix moves towards technical support. The model is performing exactly as well as it was. Any detector that alerts here is producing a false positive, and this scenario is in the panel specifically to catch detectors that cannot tell the difference.
scenarios.symptom: nothing is wrong; the questions changed
scenarios.title: Input population shift

scenarios.story: A safety filter is tuned upstream. Refusals climb from 2% to 18% over a fortnight. Every refusal is a 200 with a polite, well formed body, and the user is simply not helped.
scenarios.symptom: the assistant declines a growing share of answerable questions
scenarios.title: Refusal creep

scenarios.story: A deploy drops a field from the prompt template for one topic. Ninety two percent of traffic is unaffected, which is what makes it survive: every aggregate is diluted by a factor of twelve and the golden set never touches the affected topic.
scenarios.symptom: 8% of traffic gets a truncated answer
scenarios.title: Prompt template regression
